When the PCIEX8 slot is populated, the PCIEX16 slot operates at up to x8 mode. 1 x PCI Express x16 slot (PCIEX4), integrated in the Chipset: Supporting PCIe 4.0*/3.0 x4 mode * For AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series/3000 Series Processors only. * Actual support may vary by AMD CPU's specification
